text:
emily_sales: Heads-up \u2014 demo with FinLedger in 30m. They posted 20 PDFs as base64 in one JSON and hit 413. Need fast fix.

raj_eng: 413 = edge proxy rejecting large body. We have client_max_body_size=4MB default. Base64 bloats payload ~33%.

mike_support: Quick client options: 1) gzip client-side and set Content-Encoding: gzip, 2) presign + upload then call /ingest with key, 3) chunk and send only relevant snippets.

emily_sales: They want a single request for the live demo. Can gzip solve it?

raj_eng: Yes for the edge limit. Example curl (small):
```
echo -n "$(cat combined.txt)" | gzip -c | curl -X POST \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
  -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' \
  --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate?model=rwd-4x
```
Note: tokens are charged after decompression, so still watch cost.

mike_support: Also warn them: do NOT base64 the files inside JSON. If they must send binary, use presign.

emily_sales: They also got intermittent 429 when retrying. Why?

raj_eng: If client retries fast after 413 it can hit rate limits. 413 is a client error  don't retry automatically. For 429 use exponential backoff.

mike_support: If you need guaranteed demo success, we can temporarily whitelist their IP and bump the proxy limit for 60m. Requires SOC sign-off.

emily_sales: Demo in 25m. Could we get a 1-hour whitelist?

infra_bot: ticket-8821 created: proxy-increase-request for IP 198.51.100.23 -> target client_max_body_size 50MB for 60m. Approval pending. ETA ~15m.

raj_eng: If whitelist isn't ready, fallback presign flow (three steps). Quick cURL: 
1) presign: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/presign -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"filename":"bundle.zip"}'`
2) upload: `curl -X PUT "<upload_url>" --upload-file bundle.zip`
3) ingest: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/ingest -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"s3_key":"<key>","model":"rwd-4x"}'`

mike_support: I'll DM them both snippets and highlight token cost + no auto-retries on 413.

emily_sales: Thanks. Please post once the whitelist is approved so I can tell the customer. Session id is fin-req-44.

infra_bot: update: ticket-8821 approved by SOC -> change applied. client_max_body_size increased for IP 198.51.100.23 to 50MB for 60m. Audit id: AUD-7742.

emily_sales: Amazing, sending gzipped curl now and the presign option as a fallback. Will report after the demo. :thumbsup:
